# Release Engine v13.4.0: the release PR (preparation leaf of #20655)

## Context

The cut record #20655 holds the gate ticks and the cut mechanics for 13.4.0. `publish.mjs prepare` opens the release PR against a preparation leaf, and that PR resolves the leaf. The record therefore stays open until `finish`, npm and the Portal read back. This ticket is that leaf. It was filed with the record, and `prepare` runs once the bump leaf #20656 has merged.

## The Problem

Nothing to fix. The leaf exists so the release PR has exactly one standalone `Resolves` line, and so the record can keep its post-merge ticks.

## The Architectural Reality

`buildScripts/release/publish.mjs`:
- **`prepare` preflight:** on `dev` at `origin/dev`, a clean tree, `package.json` at 13.4.0, `.github/RELEASE_NOTES/v13.4.0.md` present, no `v13.4.0` tag.
- **`prepare` then:** checks the body against this leaf, drops older notes, stamps the note, runs `prepare.mjs` and `build-all`, commits once to `release/v13.4.0` and opens the PR to `dev`.
- **`finish`:** squashes the merge onto `main` with the atomic-commit line, tags it and creates the release, which publishes through `npm-publish.yml` (OIDC).

## The Fix

Run `prepare --rehearse`, then `prepare`, with this leaf as `--ticket` and the release PR body as `--body-file`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: The release PR's head carries `prepare`'s release commit on top of `dev` at #20658's merge, plus two note fixes the operator asked for after `prepare` ran: Clio named among the builders, and the live header groups demo linked with a *What you can try* section.
- [ ] AC-2: `package.json` and the lock's root read 13.4.0, and `v13.4.0.md` is the only note under `.github/RELEASE_NOTES/`.
- [ ] AC-3: The release PR passed `dev`'s required checks and CodeQL, with no ruleset bypass.
- [ ] AC-4 (post-merge, recorded on #20655): `finish` succeeded; the GitHub release `Neo.mjs v13.4.0 Release Notes` ends with the atomic-commit line; `npm view neo.mjs@latest version` reads 13.4.0.

## Out of Scope

The gate (ticked on #20655), the bump (#20656), the notes (#20497), and the Brain post-release sync, Pages and create-app.
